maddeler.e:
اصطنعوا (form VIII)
# اِصْطَنَعُوا (iṣṭanaʕū) /isˤ.tˤa.na.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِصْطَنَعَ (iṣṭanaʕa)
# اُصْطُنِعُوا (uṣṭuniʕū) /usˤ.tˤu.ni.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِصْطَنَعَ (iṣṭanaʕa)
# اِصْطَنِعُوا (iṣṭaniʕū) /isˤ.tˤa.ni.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِصْطَنَعَ (iṣṭanaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
